guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice has the largest anomaly (latency-50 +858.7%, z=+171.75) and is the only service with disk I/O going from 0 to 4022.78 (z=+20), while the upstream frontend and checkoutservice latencies rise as a consequence. Socket (+49%) and CPU (+47%) also rose on currencyservice, but their z-scores are lower than disk I/O, and the logs have no errors to separate them.

proposed_fix.description: Find the process causing heavy disk I/O on the currencyservice pod (e.g. logging, temp file writes) and stop or throttle it. If that is not possible, restart or reschedule the pod onto a node with healthy disk. No data deletion is required.
